lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
U.S. air travel is recovering smoothly after a nationwide ground stop, though some passengers are both weary and wary after repeated flight delays and cancellations, The Canadian Press reports.

Jensen Huang is considering a comeback as Nvidia’s NVDA.O chief executive, and has discussed with confidants the possibility of returning, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter, The Associated Press reports.

Two planes collided Saturday night on the tarmac at Miami International Airport, just a day after a nationwide flight grounding caused widespread cancellations and travel chaos, The Canadian Press reports.
Dems can win more in Mississippi if they spend money, Scott Colom says, Politico reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
